시편-143-1.title: 시편 143장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-143-1.exegesis: 7. (Compare Psa 25:17 ). that I may praise-- literally, "for praising," or, "that Thy name may be praised," that is, by the righteous, who shall surround me with sympathizing joy ( Psa 35:27 ).

시편-143-2.title: 시편 143장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-143-2.exegesis: PSALM 143 Psa 143:1-12 . In structure and style, like the preceding (Psalms 104-142), this Psalm is clearly evinced to be David's. It is a prayer for pardon, and for relief from enemies; afflictions, as usual, producing confession and penitence. 1. in thy faithfulness ... and ... righteousness-- or, God's regard to the claims which He has permitted His people to make in His covenant.

시편-143-3.title: 시편 143장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-143-3.exegesis: 2. enter ... judgment-- deal not in strict justice. shall no ... justified-- or, "is no man justified," or "innocent" ( Job 14:3 ; Ro 3:20 ).

시편-143-4.title: 시편 143장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-143-4.exegesis: 3-4. The exciting reason for his prayer-- his afflictions--led to confession as just made: he now makes the complaint. as those that have been long dead-- deprived of life's comforts (compare Psa 40:15 ; 88:3-6 ).

시편-143-6.title: 시편 143장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-143-6.exegesis: 5-6. The distress is aggravated by the contrast of former comfort ( Psa 22:3-5 ), for whose return he longs. a thirsty land-- which needs rain, as did his spirit God's gracious visits ( Psa 28:1 ; 89:17 ).
